Hard.description: Every CELStepEvent serialises to a deterministic canonical dict; keys sorted, no float values, timestamps are ISO-8601 strings.
HMAC-SHA256 links each event to its predecessor; broken chains raise LEFChainViolation immediately.
subscribe/unsubscribe are passive observer operations only; they never mutate CEL execution state.
event_stream() is read/drain only; zero ledger writes occur inside the SSE generator.
A cycle that exits without COMPLETE or BLOCKED raises LEFFeedIncomplete immediately.
